definitions.meaning: bị áp đảo, quá tải, không thể đối phó được

examples: She felt overwhelmed by the amount of work she had to do.
Moving to a new city can feel overwhelming at first.

definitions.meaning: lo lắng, hồi hộp, bồn chồn

examples: He felt anxious before the job interview and couldn't sleep.
She gets anxious in large crowds and prefers smaller gatherings.

definitions.meaning: mãn nguyện, hài lòng, thỏa mãn

examples: She was content with a simple life in the countryside.
After a good meal with family, he felt truly content.

definitions.meaning: bực bội, thất vọng vì không đạt được điều mình muốn

examples: He was frustrated when his computer crashed right before saving his work.
She felt frustrated that nobody was listening to her ideas.

definitions.meaning: biết ơn, cảm kích

examples: She was deeply grateful for all the support her friends gave her.
He wrote a thank-you note to show how grateful he felt.

definitions.meaning: nỗi u sầu, cảm giác buồn bã kéo dài, ưu tư
u sầu, buồn bã, ảm đạm

examples: A sense of melancholy came over her as she looked at old photographs.
The rainy afternoon gave the whole town a melancholy feeling.

definitions.meaning: nhẹ nhõm, thoải mái sau khi lo lắng hoặc căng thẳng

examples: She was relieved to hear that her test results were normal.
He felt relieved when he finally finished the difficult project.

definitions.meaning: ghen tị, đố kỵ

examples: He was jealous of his colleague's promotion and struggled to hide it.
She felt jealous when she saw her ex with someone new.

definitions.meaning: tự hào, hãnh diện

examples: Her parents were proud of her when she graduated at the top of her class.
He felt proud after completing his first marathon.

definitions.meaning: xấu hổ, hổ thẹn về hành động của mình

examples: She was ashamed of how she had treated her friend and apologised immediately.
He felt ashamed for lying, even though no one found out.

definitions.meaning: phấn khích, vô cùng vui mừng

examples: She was thrilled to get tickets to her favourite band's concert.
The children were thrilled when they saw the snow for the first time.

definitions.meaning: ngượng ngùng, bối rối vì xấu hổ trước người khác

examples: He was embarrassed when he called his teacher 'Mum' by accident.
She felt embarrassed about forgetting her colleague's name.

definitions.meaning: cô đơn, cảm thấy thiếu sự kết nối với người khác

examples: Living alone in a new city made her feel lonely at first.
He was surrounded by people but still felt lonely inside.

definitions.meaning: đầy hy vọng, lạc quan về tương lai

examples: Despite the setbacks, she remained hopeful that things would improve.
He was hopeful about his chances of getting the job after the interview.

definitions.meaning: bực mình, khó chịu vì điều gì đó nhỏ nhặt

examples: She was irritated by the constant noise coming from next door.
He got irritated when the meeting ran over its scheduled time.

definitions.meaning: hoài niệm, nhớ về quá khứ với tình cảm ấm áp và đôi chút tiếc nuối

examples: Hearing that old song made her feel nostalgic about her school days.
He became nostalgic when he visited his hometown after ten years.

definitions.meaning: tự tin, tin tưởng vào khả năng của bản thân

examples: She walked into the room feeling confident and ready to present her ideas.
He became more confident after practising his speech several times.

definitions.meaning: cảm thấy có lỗi, mang cảm giác tội lỗi

examples: She felt guilty about eating the last piece of cake without asking.
He had a guilty conscience after cancelling on his friend at the last minute.

definitions.meaning: tò mò, muốn tìm hiểu hoặc biết thêm

examples: She was curious about the new neighbour who had just moved in.
Children are naturally curious and love asking questions.

definitions.meaning: chán nản, không hứng thú vì thiếu kích thích

examples: He was bored during the long meeting because none of the topics were relevant to him.
She felt bored on rainy days when she had nothing to do.

definitions.meaning: tan nát cõi lòng, đau khổ tột cùng vì mất mát hoặc thất tình

examples: She was heartbroken when her relationship of five years came to an end.
He was heartbroken after losing his beloved dog.

definitions.meaning: thoải mái, không căng thẳng, cảm thấy yên bình

examples: She felt at ease in the company of old friends.
His calm voice put the nervous patient at ease.

definitions.meaning: cay đắng, oán hận do bị đối xử bất công hoặc thất vọng

examples: He was bitter about losing the promotion to a less experienced colleague.
She tried not to feel bitter after the breakup, but it was difficult.

definitions.meaning: xúc động, cảm động sâu sắc

examples: She was deeply moved by the soldier's story of sacrifice.
He was moved to tears watching his daughter's first dance recital.

definitions.meaning: thiếu tự tin, không chắc chắn về bản thân, dễ bị lung lay

examples: She felt insecure about her English and avoided speaking in meetings.
Growing up without stability made him feel insecure in relationships.
